t: The Saxby Anchorage LED bathroom ceiling light is a modern, round satin nickel fitting designed for reliable illumination in domestic bathrooms. This 9W integrated LED light delivers 650 lumens of cool white 4000K light, making it suitable for tasks and general ambient lighting in zone 2 bathroom areas. Constructed with a durable steel body and a tempered glass diffuser, it offers an IP44 rating for splash protection. Fixings and fittings are supplied for straightforward installation, ensuring a professional finish.
